title: Two days in Nha Trang
summary: One island boat on the first day. Po Nagar, Long Son, and Dam Market on the second. Po Nagar is a morning and the adult ticket is 22,000 VND.

days.title: Day 1 — One island
days.body: Take Hon Mun or Hon Tre. Each is a day on the water. Fees are Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 2 — Po Nagar and the shore
days.body: Po Nagar in the morning. An adult ticket is 22,000 VND. Then Long Son, a daylight climb, and Dam Market. Those fees are Check on arrival, and Dam Market is free.

stops.name: Po Nagar

stops.name: Long Son
